items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: They were interviewed in Los Angeles by Monk Rowe on

ctx.x: Ross Tompkins is a Detroit native who studied piano at the New England Conservatory. From 1960-67 he freelanced in New York, performing with Clark Terry, Kai Winding, Herb Ellis and other major artists. He joined his friend Tommy Newsom in the Tonight Show Band and held down the piano chair for the duration, also performing with the Louis Bellson Big Band in Los Angeles. He records frequently as a sideman and as a solo pianist.
Tommy and Ross can be found performing at festivals and jazz parties across the country. They were interviewed in Los Angeles by Monk Rowe on

Good afternoon. We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe, and it’s a great pleasure today to have two guests who are fixtures in the jazz scene, especially on the west coast here. Can I call you guys “fixtures?”
